name: heart sight
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} touches a creature and magically knows the creature's current emotional state.
If the target fails a  DC 10 Charisma saving throw, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} also knows the creature's alignment. Celestials, fiends, and undead automatically fail the saving throw.
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} touches a creature. target must make a Charisma saving throw.
